takeaways.statement: Auto-updating the claude.md file before every git commit ensures every new session starts with perfect context.
Using the 'clear' command is superior to letting sessions 'compact' because it resets context and saves tokens more effectively.
Output quality degrades after more than two session compactions; fresh starts are better for complex work.
The 'ultrathink' command forces the AI to perform a deeper analysis of the problem for higher-quality results.
Forcing clarifying questions in planning mode via the claude.md file prevents errors and catches missed assumptions.
